Our California team comprises 24 professionals across four offices — Oakland, Sacramento, Monterey, and Pasadena. * Experience with standard analytical tools like Microsoft Excel and geographic information systems (GIS); familiarity with computer scripting and hydrologic modeling software are beneficial
* Experience preparing technical reports and presenting work during group meetings with coworkers and clients
